task_definition.task_description: Please look up Alice’s contact info, then search for headphones in electronics and, if the Sony WH-1000XM5 in black leads to alternatives, pick a suitable recommended substitute, place a hold for 1 unit, and complete the order. After that, book the best meeting room for 4 people on 2026-02-15 from 10:00 to 11:00, schedule a “Purchase Review Meeting” with Alice and Bob for that time, create a document called “Purchase and Meeting Summary” noting that the substitute purchase was completed and the follow-up meeting was scheduled, then email Alice that update, and then send the same email to both Alice and Bob.

user_input.query: Please look up Alice’s contact info, then search for headphones in the electronics category. I want the product with ID p_sony_xm5_blk, and if the Sony WH-1000XM5 in black leads to alternatives, choose a suitable recommended substitute, place a hold for quantity 1, and complete the purchase using card_visa. After that, book the best meeting room for 4 attendees on 2026-02-15 from 2026-02-15 10:00 to 2026-02-15 11:00, and schedule a “Purchase Review Meeting” for that time with alice@company.com and bob@company.com. Then create a document titled “Purchase and Meeting Summary” with the content “Substitute product order completed and follow-up meeting scheduled.” and tags shopping, office, and followup. Finally, email Alice with subject “Order Complete and Meeting Scheduled” and body “The substitute purchase has been completed and the follow-up meeting is scheduled.”, then send the same email to both alice@company.com and bob@company.com.
